Messages.Author: pallando
Messages.Body:
i considered putting a few malkavian dementias in my decks because we have
lots of malks around here. now i've got two questions. i take controll of a
malavian during my master phase.
1. can i use a blood doll already on the vampire to move one blood to my
pool?
2. can one of my other vampires take an equipment from the malkavian as a +1
stealth action?
thanks
pallando

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Tue, 25 Apr 2000, pallando wrote:
> 1. can i use a blood doll already on the vampire to move one blood to my
> pool?

Yes. The text on Blood Doll is very specific that the Controller of the
vampire with the card (rather than the Controller of Blood Doll, which is
still the person who played it) can use it.

> 2. can one of my other vampires take an equipment from the malkavian as a +1
> stealth action?

Yep.
